calculators.name: pl_vat
calculators.title: Polish VAT: net, VAT and gross
calculators.description: Polish VAT: net, VAT and gross. Arithmetic at the user-confirmed rate; does not decide whether VAT is deductible or reverse charge applies. All input and output amounts are PLN, not grosze. Ask for required inputs; never infer country, year, VAT status or relief eligibility from language. Do not send names, NIP, email, documents or account identifiers.

year.description: Tax year. This API currently supports 2026 only; do not substitute it for another requested year.

calculators.name: de_vat
calculators.title: German VAT: net, VAT and gross
calculators.description: German VAT: net, VAT and gross. VAT arithmetic only. Confirm the rate and whether VAT should be charged; a Kleinunternehmer normally does not charge VAT. Do not infer exemption or reverse charge from a zero rate. Ask for required inputs; never infer country, year, VAT status or relief eligibility from language. Do not send names, NIP, email, documents or account identifiers.

year.description: Tax year. This API currently supports 2026 only; do not substitute it for another requested year.
